question: Will Marko Livaja receive a yellow card vs HNK Gorica on Oct 31, 2026 (regular time + stoppage time only)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Marko Livaja is shown at least one yellow card during regulation time or stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalty shootout) of the HNL Round 12 match between Hajduk Split and HNK Gorica, played strictly after 2026-10-31T01:00:54.980Z and with the match result confirmed at or before 2026-10-31T22:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if Marko Livaja is not shown any yellow card during regulation time or stoppage time of the same match within the same window, including if he does not appear in the match at all.

Clarifications:
- Only yellow cards issued during the 90 minutes of regular time plus any added stoppage time at the end of each half count; cards shown in extra time or a penalty shootout do not count.
- If Marko Livaja receives a second yellow card (resulting in a red), that first yellow card still counts for this market.
